title: GIG-3192: Create New Worktrees From The Latest Origin Integration Branch
description: New ngramx worktree branches fork from the origin integration commit without tracking main, so Codabyte starts from latest main and a bare git push cannot update it.

test_plan.description: Unit tests cover stale HEAD, dirty parent, fetch failure, and master-only remotes
steps: In the ngramx-dev container run vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'GitRepositoryServiceTest|WorktreeCommandTest'

test_plan.description: A new worktree on a stale parent checkout still starts from latest origin/main
steps: In a clone whose local main is behind origin/main and whose HEAD is on a feature branch, run ngramx worktree gig-3192-verify --no-interaction
Confirm the new branch tip matches origin/main and includes commits that were missing from the parent HEAD
Confirm the parent checkout stayed on the feature branch

test_plan.description: New ticket branches do not track origin/main
steps: In the ngramx-dev container run vendor/bin/phpunit --filter test_addWorktreeWithNewBranch_does_not_set_upstream_to_origin_main
Confirm the new branch tip equals origin/main and git rev-parse branch@{u} fails (no upstream)
After creating a worktree with ngramx worktree, run git -C <worktree> rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} and confirm it is unset
